title: Demo contract — one per feature, verified by someone else
description:
Every lane that builds a FEATURE must ship a runnable demo. A demo is not a screenshot and not a paragraph claiming it works: it is a non-interactive script that another agent runs, on a machine that is not the builder's, and observes. Self-certification does not count.

This plugs into the demo rig that already exists (demo/, task-36) rather than inventing a second one — demo/db-guard.mjs already refuses to run against the live host and database, and demo/seed.sql already holds four months of shifts.

required.description: false ONLY for lanes that ship no user-visible behaviour (PM docs, FIELD research). Every lane that changes what a worker or the director can see or do must set this true.

whatYouSee.description: Plain English, in the product's terms, not the code's. 'A raise is recorded, and a payroll report for the PRIOR month still prints the original figure' — not 'worker_rates INSERT succeeds'.

runsAgainst.description: The seeded demo database only. demo/db-guard.mjs must be called first — a demo that can touch the live payroll database is a production incident waiting to happen.

exitCodeMeaning.description: The script must be non-interactive and must exit non-zero when the thing it demonstrates is broken. A demo that always exits 0 proves nothing.

isDifferentFromBuilder.description: Hard requirement. The agent that wrote the feature may not be the agent that certifies its demo.

observedOutput.description: What the verifier actually saw. Pasted, not summarised.
